subject: PO format, batching invoices, and quarterly invoice sweep - Helianthos
messages:
From: Monique Lefebvre <monique.lefebvre@helianthos.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@helianthos.com
Date: 2027-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO format / consolidated quarterly invoices question

Hi Aditya,

Quick procurement question as we move toward finalizing the SOW for Helianthos: our finance team prefers to issue a blanket PO that covers multiple months and POs can be referenced on consolidated quarterly invoices. Can Redwood accept a single invoice that lists multiple PO numbers across separate invoice lines?

A few specifics they asked me to confirm:
- Net terms: they prefer Net45 for vendor payments. Is Net45 acceptable?
- Invoice fields: they need a line-level PO number, project code (GL code), and a mandatory PO approval reference on the invoice PDF.
- Batching cadence: our standard practice is quarterly consolidated invoices (one invoice per quarter) unless there’s a reason to invoice monthly.

Also attaching an example of the PO template they normally send (PO_Example_12345.pdf). If you have a sample invoice or a list of required invoice fields that we can share with finance, that would speed things up.

Separately, are there any pricing implications for consolidated quarterly billing vs monthly (e.g., early-pay discount or prepayment incentive)?

Thanks — we’re trying to keep this tight so procurement can issue a blanket PO this week.

Best,
Monique
Procurement Manager | Helianthos Therapeutics
[Attachment: PO_Example_12345.pdf (PDF)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monique Lefebvre <monique.lefebvre@helianthos.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-08T12:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format / consolidated quarterly invoices question

Hi Monique — thanks for the clear note and the sample PO. Happy to confirm how we can support Helianthos. Short answers up front: yes on multiple PO numbers on a single invoice (with caveats), we can accommodate Net45 with approval, and we can offer a small credit for quarterly prepayment. Details below.

Options we typically offer (pick one):
1) Standard monthly invoices: one invoice per month, PO number(s) appear on each line as provided. Standard payment terms: Net30; no discount.
2) Quarterly consolidated invoice (your preference): we can issue a single invoice per quarter that lists each PO and line-level references. Requires a blanket PO that explicitly permits consolidated invoicing and lists expected PO numbers or a PO range. We can accept Net45 for this account if Finance approves the exception (see internal note CC’d). We can offer a 3% credit applied to the quarter if Helianthos agrees to net-45 payment within 30 days of invoice receipt (i.e., an early-pay window).
3) Prepaid / committed credit: customer prepays the quarter upfront for a 5% discount vs metered monthly billing. Good for predictable consumption.

Practical constraints we need to flag: our finance system requires a PO number on the invoice line that maps to the contract/GL code — if your PO template lists multiple PO numbers per line we’ll need the canonical PO-to-GL mapping in a spreadsheet. I’ve attached a short invoice template that shows the fields we need filled out: Invoice_Template_Helianthos.xlsx. Also attaching the current SOW draft for signatures: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf.

Next steps I propose:
- If you want quarterly consolidated invoices and Net45, please confirm and have procurement include an explicit line in the blanket PO indicating permission for consolidated invoicing and that Net45 is acceptable.
- Send the PO-to-GL mapping in the attached invoice template so our billing team can validate mappings before the first consolidated invoice.
- If you choose the prepay option for a 5% discount, let me know and I’ll route an approval request to Finance.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that’s faster.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.com/aditya-30
[Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF), Invoice_Template_Helianthos.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-03-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO format / consolidated quarterly invoices question — approval request

Vanessa / Priyom — forwarding the procurement thread with Helianthos. They want a blanket PO and quarterly consolidated invoices and are asking for Net45. Proposal options I outlined: quarterly consolidated with 3% early-pay credit, or prepaid quarter for 5% discount. They expect a blanket PO this week.

Key asks for Finance/Revenue ops:
- Can we approve Net45 for this account? Helianthos is an enterprise biotech with an initial 6-month commitment (see SOW).
- If we accept consolidated quarterly invoices, we need billing to accept multiple PO numbers on a single invoice with line-level mapping to GL codes. They will provide the mapping in the attached template.
- Approve a one-time 5% discount if they choose prepaid quarterly commit (commercial approval required).

I’ve included the draft SOW and invoice template in the thread. Please advise by EOD 3/10 if we can greenlight Net45 + quarterly consolidation and the prepaid discount.

- Issue a blanket PO that authorizes consolidated quarterly invoices and lists the PO IDs that will be covered,
- Populate the Invoice_Template_Helianthos.xlsx with PO-to-GL mappings and return it by EOD 3/12,
